title: the cairn device's trouble-panel proof measures only the cairn device: render and fold teeth leave, the pane, probe and sweep teeth arrive
intention: cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_trouble_panel.py measures two other devices: four render teeth import web_server's render (:155-188), the end-to-end and second-raise teeth import trouble's shim and web_server's render (:222-223, :275), and the socket-route tooth imports web_server's listener (:306). The render, fold and socket teeth already berth with their owners (609b038a1958, edf5835d2e95). What the cairn device owes in their place: the store-to-pane read timed inside the 1s budget, the pane and its probe reading with every dial refused, the 30-day sweep reaching the trouble store, and the panel owning no route of its own.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds trouble names cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_trouble_panel.py:155,168,178,188 (web_server render), :222,275 (trouble shim), :223 (web_server render), :306 (web_server listener). RULE 1: a ticket's proofs measure only that component.
traces_to: CLAUDE.md RULE 1; outline 2.3.7.1 (trouble publishes its store tool; readers read through it); outline 17.13.1.
how: test_trouble_panel.py: the render section, the second-raise tooth and the websocket tooth go. The raise-to-rendered-pane tooth becomes test_a_stored_trouble_reaches_the_PANE_inside_the_budget (seeded store files, the pane handler timed under 1s), still carrying 9579a6f9cec6 clause 5. New teeth test_the_pane_and_its_probe_read_with_no_bus (bus_client.reach refused), test_the_30_day_sweep_reaches_the_trouble_store (a 31-day-old cleared file under the published store tool's store_root is swept, a fresh one stays) and test_the_panel_owns_no_route_of_its_own (7a1265439f54 clause 1 re-pointed onto it). New proof cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_cairn_proofs_measure_only_cairn.py carries the sieve and forbidden-module teeth.

clauses.claim: no RULE 1 breach from a file under cairn/devices/cairn lands on web_server or trouble
the trouble-panel proof names no module of web_server nor trouble's shim, device or old door
a trouble in the store reaches the cairn pane's data inside 1s, and the pane and its probe read it with every bus dial refused
the 30-day sweep removes a 31-day-old cleared ticket under the trouble store and keeps a fresh one

decisions.text: D1: the cairn device keeps the part of the trouble lane that is its own (store to pane, the probe, the sweep, no route of its own) and drops the render, fold and socket teeth to their owners.
